task: Creative track: a new Hearth & Horizon science fiction story, 'Every Other Flash' (text only)

doc_friction.issue: Saints by Candlelight was the natural pick, but episode 147 was already open in two duplicate PRs (#17572, #17573), and the episode test forbids gaps in numbering, so episode 148 could not land first. Switched to Hearth & Horizon. A note in PRODUCTION.md saying 'claim the next number in a draft PR first' would save the check.

notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon; piece: every-other-flash (Hearth & Horizon shelf, 2054, Toulouse and Ifrane, about 5,860 words, text only because the audio folders total 577 MB, over the 400 MB line). Proposal claimed in BIBLE.md first (draft PR #17576), then marked done and moved to DONE.md by bible_done.mjs. Numbers worked in a script: 780 km circular orbit, 100.5 min, 14.3 orbits/day; about 203 m/s to a 50 km perigee; about 160 kg of propellant at Isp 320 s for a 2,550 kg stack; 41 s flash period, 82 s spin, 4.39 vs 8.78 deg/s; inertia model Ix 1360 > Iz 1312 kg m2 so end-over-end spin; ring about 0.98 m from the c.m. at 7.5 cm/s; wing tip 7.0 m at 0.54 m/s. Dates checked: 25 Oct 2054 is the 30th Sunday in Ordinary Time, Year B, Mark 10:46-52; 1 Nov 2054 is a Sunday (All Saints). Ground-track times were checked against the dawn-dusk geometry (capture over the Southern Ocean at 09 UTC, deorbit over the South Pacific at 03 UTC). Verification: node --test in hearth-and-horizon 20/20; python3 platform/ci/run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes ran 11/11 selected workflows and exited 0.
